title: Ask for the awkward case before buying automation
hooks: Someone offers to automate your whole workflow. Ask to see the awkward case first.
Buying an AI workflow? Bring one difficult example to the demo.
What happens when the enquiry is missing a deadline? Ask before you buy.
full_spoken_english: Someone offers to automate your whole workflow. Ask to see the awkward case first. Choose one repeated task, such as turning enquiry notes into a draft response. Bring a fictional example with a missing detail. Ask what goes in, what comes out, and who checks it. Then ask what happens when that detail is missing. Does the system stop, ask a question, or quietly guess? Watch the answer in the test instead of filling it in yourself. Before agreeing to a wider build, get the open questions in writing: access, running costs, maintenance, and responsibility when something breaks. A successful small example answers a small question. Keep the unanswered ones on the page. For your next AI proposal, add one line: show us how this handles our difficult example. What would you put in that example?
cta: For your next AI proposal, add one line: show us how this handles our difficult example. What would you put in that example?

fixture.input: Fictional proposal promises enquiry drafting. Test enquiry has no agreed deadline.
fixture.designed_output: Draft asks for the deadline; open questions list access, costs, maintenance and responsibility.
fixture.check: No guessed deadline; contract outcome and actual provider capability remain untested.

audio_plan: Natural recorded voice; no imitation. Quiet room; optional subtle licensed music only after voice intelligibility check. No sound needed to understand proof panels.
caption_plan: Editable sentence captions, maximum two short lines; keep proof labels clear. Captions paraphrase nothing that changes a fact. Final platform safe-zone check after edit.
